description:
About the job

Description

Amazon Mexico's Media Retail team is looking for a data driven, customer-obsessed, hands on and creative candidate to join our team. As a Brand Specialist, you'll own selected brands to help drive growth and help deliver a best-in-class customer experience on Amazon.com.mx, while facilitating great business relationships with some of Amazon's highest visibility brands.

Key job responsibilities

You'll be responsible for looking after the brands' product portfolio, contributing to improvements in the user experience for customers and creating detailed weekly reports on performance. You'll lead presentations and planning sessions with vendors and act as the main point of contact for them.

You will also provide support to drive business growth through detailed analysis of business inefficiencies and identifying solutions; proposing changes to operational processes; driving a high standard in customer satisfaction; ensuring high-quality product detail pages; and making recommendations for effective marketing campaigns.

To achieve success in this role, you will have strong analytical and relationship management skills. You are comfortable picking up new technologies and skills quickly. You'll be a problem solver, identifying issues or opportunity areas to then create plans to drive improvement.

As a Brand Specialist, You Will Be Fully Involved In All Business Functions Of Your Brands, Including Onsite Marketing, Vendor Relation Management And In-stock Management. Some Of The Tasks Associated With These Functions Include


 Online marketing: improving product page data, developing marketing and merchandising plans, improving customer experience onsite, helping generating traffic and sales
 Vendor management: help growing selection of products to sell on Amazon, onboarding new vendors, identifying and resolving pricing issues
 In-stock management: tracking purchase orders, investigating late deliveries, resolving order rejections, working with vendors on PO automation.


About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 1+ years of account management, project or program management or buying experience
 Experience using analytical specific tools such as Google Analytics, SQL or HTML
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience in process improvement
 Experience managing large amounts of data


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
About the job

Docente online de Psicología Clínica | Convocatoria IEDUC 2026




En IEDUC buscamos profesionales de la psicología con experiencia clínica y formación especializada que deseen integrarse a nuestro equipo docente.




La colaboración consiste en impartir un seminario online dentro del área de especialidad de cada docente, articulando fundamentos teóricos, análisis clínico y herramientas de intervención. Buscamos una enseñanza rigurosa, actualizada y vinculada con los desafíos reales de la práctica profesional.




Áreas de especialización




Buscamos perfiles con formación y experiencia en modelos cognitivo-conductuales y contextuales —TCC, ACT o DBT—, Terapia Breve Centrada en Soluciones, intervención clínica en duelo o Terapia de Juego.




Responsabilidades

Revisar y validar el programa y los materiales proporcionados por IEDUC.
Proponer, en coordinación con el equipo académico, las adecuaciones que resulten pertinentes.
Impartir las sesiones virtuales conforme a los objetivos y la estructura del seminario.
Facilitar el análisis clínico, las actividades prácticas y la participación del grupo.




Perfil requerido




• Licenciatura en Psicología con título y cédula profesional.

• Formación especializada comprobable en el área de postulación.

• Experiencia clínica vigente y relacionada con el enfoque.

• Capacidad para comunicar contenidos clínicos de manera clara y estructurada.




Valoramos además:




Posgrado, certificaciones o entrenamientos en el enfoque; así como experiencia docente, capacitación, supervisión clínica o formación de profesionales de la salud mental. Estos elementos fortalecerán la candidatura, pero no es necesario reunirlos todos.




Características de la colaboración:




• Modalidad completamente online, con sesiones en vivo. Pueden postularse profesionales de cualquier estado de México.

• Colaboración profesional remunerada, temporal y por seminario.

• Periodo académico: septiembre a noviembre de 2026.

• IEDUC proporciona el programa y los contenidos temáticos del seminario. El docente deberá revisarlos, validarlos y acordar con el equipo académico las adecuaciones pertinentes, así como diseñar las actividades, ejercicios y recursos didácticos necesarios para favorecer la aplicación de los contenidos.

• El calendario, la carga académica, los alcances y los honorarios se compartirán antes de formalizar la colaboración, de acuerdo con el seminario asignado.




Postulación

Si tu formación y experiencia se relacionan con alguna de estas áreas, envíanos:

• CV actualizado.

• Área de especialización a la que deseas postularte.

• Breve descripción de tu experiencia clínica y docente.

• Disponibilidad durante el periodo señalado.




Postúlate directamente a través de LinkedIn o envía tu información a contacto@ieduc.com.mx

Asunto: Postulación docente | [Área de especialización]




En IEDUC buscamos profesionales que conozcan profundamente su disciplina y sepan convertir su experiencia clínica en una formación rigurosa, clara y significativa.

description:
About the job

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Position Title: Consumer Digital Ecosystem Senior Associate

Job Level: P2 Location: Mexico

Supervisor: Joseba Barriola Potts

Consumer Digital Ecosystem is a core commercial role within the Eli Lilly Mexico Affiliate, built to translate multi-sourced data (B2B, Consumer, Marketing, and more) into prioritized commercial decisions that drive resource allocation, field execution, and consumer strategies. The position owns the full data consumption-analysis-transformation cycle and works with internal partners (brand teams, commercial teams, global teams, subject matter experts) as well as external partners (technology vendors, digital agencies, telehealth providers, e-commerce platforms) to build and scale consumer-facing digital capabilities that directly unlock new revenue channels and strengthen direct-to-patient relationships.

The Senior Associate needs deep understanding of digital ecosystems, commercial data, and consumer behavior to couple data-driven insights with business strategy and execute high-impact digital initiatives. The Senior Associate demonstrates an innate drive to innovate, a bias for action, and the ability to create seamless consumer experiences that optimize sell-through and build lasting patient relationships.

The Position

We are seeking a data-savvy, digitally-fluent, and strategically-minded individual to join our team as a Consumer Digital Ecosystem Senior Associate. In this role, you will own everything related to the digital ecosystem that directly impacts the consumer and the business — from e-commerce and telehealth to direct-to-consumer selling models and consumer digital journeys. You will be the single dedicated resource accountable for translating data into commercial decisions that optimize digital revenue channels, enhance patient relationships, and drive sell-through across an optimized digital experience.

As a Consumer Digital Ecosystem Senior Associate, your main responsibilities will be to:


Implement a comprehensive E-Commerce strategy: design, launch, and continuously optimize Lilly’s e-commerce capabilities to drive product accessibility, sell-through, and revenue growth through digital retail channels.
Launch a telehealth solution embedded in Lilly.com: lead end-to-end implementation of a telehealth capability integrated within Lilly’s digital ecosystem to extend the reach of care, facilitate patient-physician connections, and enhance the direct-to-patient value proposition.
Build and own a clear Consumer Digital Journey: map, design, and continuously improve the end-to-end digital experience for consumers, ensuring seamless interactions across all digital touchpoints from awareness to purchase and adherence.
Own the data consumption-analysis-transformation cycle: integrate and synthesize multi-sourced data (B2B, consumer, marketing, etc.) to generate actionable commercial insights, prioritize resource allocation, and inform field and consumer strategies.
Drive commercial decision-making through digital performance analytics: monitor key digital and commercial metrics (e-commerce conversion, telehealth adoption, digital journey KPIs) and adjust strategies to maximize business impact.
Lead cross-functional collaboration: partner with brand teams, commercial operations, IT, regulatory, medical affairs, and external vendors to align the digital ecosystem strategy with broader business and compliance priorities.
Manage and scale external digital partnerships: identify and cultivate relationships with technology partners, digital health start-ups, e-commerce platforms, and telehealth providers to continuously enhance Lilly’s digital consumer ecosystem.
Support brand teams in integrating digital ecosystem capabilities into their brand strategies, including identification of digital consumer segments, definition of digital-specific Critical Success Factors, and design of brand-level digital journeys.
Stay ahead of digital trends and innovation: continuously scan the competitive and technology landscape to identify emerging digital capabilities, tools, and models that can be adopted to maintain Lilly’s leadership in consumer-facing digital excellence.



Qualifications

About You


At least 3 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, commercial strategy, or digital ecosystem management, with a proven track record of driving business results through digital channels.
Hands-on experience managing e-commerce platforms, telehealth solutions, or direct-to-consumer digital channels, including ownership of key digital performance metrics (conversion rates, digital funnel KPIs).
Demonstrated ability to synthesize multi-source data (B2B, consumer, commercial, marketing) into actionable insights and prioritized business decisions, with experience in data analytics tools and dashboarding.
Experience leading multi-layered projects in cross-functional and cross-national environments, including collaboration with IT, medical affairs, regulatory, and external technology vendors.
Strong commercial acumen and understanding of how digital channels (e-commerce, telehealth, direct-to-patient) translate into revenue impact and resource allocation decisions.
Strong English skills to collaborate effectively with global counterparts and multinational stakeholders. Spanish proficiency required.
Deep understanding of the digital and multi-channel marketing landscape, including SFE models, CRM tools, marketing automation platforms, and consumer journey analytics. Experience with digital media execution and paid digital strategies.
Solid project management skills with the ability to prioritize competing demands, manage vendors and external partners, and deliver results in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.



Location: Mexico

Some travel is possible, up to 5-15%

REXX Studio is a venture studio that builds tech companies for legacy, underserved industries, and pre-sells the concepts directly to PE firms before they're fully built. REXX comes in as co-founder and first allocator on every company, so they have real skin in each bet.

You are the studio's full-funnel commercial operator. Your primary job is to go close - in person, on camera, or at the door, wherever the deal requires. You also build the outbound infrastructure and sales playbooks that founders inherit as they scale, and you run structured outreach to surface the domain experts who become REXX's next EIRs.

About the job

Who We Are

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

Hiring And How We Work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Deal Desk Senior Analyst.

About The Job

Twilio is looking for a curious, action-oriented, strong financial analyst for the Deal Desk Team who lives the Twilio Magic to support our LATAM Go-to-Market motion. This is an exciting role for an individual to gain and expand a broad spectrum of cross-functional interactions and contribute to non-standard commercial agreements by providing rigorous financial governance and structuring. This role partners closely with Finance leadership, Sales, Legal, and Operations to evaluate, structure, and execute deals in a way that is a “win-win” for both customers and Twilio while optimizing corporate margin goals. The ideal candidate is a proactive, driven professional, able to build complex financial models and analyze pricing structures, while providing data-driven, financially sound, and clearly communicated explanations and solutions.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:


Build and analyze financial models and pricing scenarios for standard and non-standard agreements, evaluating critical variables including pricing, discounting, term length, usage commitments, and gross margin impact.
Partner with Sales to structure commercially sound deals by analyzing tradeoffs across price, volume, and risk, ensuring all structures align with Twilio’s financial guardrails.
Act as a guardrail and educator for Sales and GTM teams, ensuring adherence to internal contracting policies, approval matrices, and discount governance.
Own the end-to-end Deal Desk operational workflow in Salesforce/CPQ (from quote building and pricing approvals to Order Form creation, DocuSign execution, and opportunity closure), ensuring 100% data integrity and policy compliance.
Establish trusted working relationships across Commercial Legal, Billing Operations, Corporate Finance, and Sales to streamline deal velocity.
Collaborate with Sales and Legal to review and structure non-standard contract language within Order Forms, ensuring alignment with corporate risk and revenue recognition policies.
Conduct ad-hoc financial analysis and modeling to support broader business decisions and strategic initiatives.
Drive and participate in cross-functional project improvement initiatives to scale Deal Desk operations, enhance systems, and optimize internal workflows.


Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!


Required:
Business proficiency or fluency in English, with solid written and verbal communication skills.
A Bachelor’s or Associate’s Degree plus a minimum of 3 years of experience in Corporate Finance, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Commercial Finance, Deal Desk or an analytical Go To Market role. If no degree, a minimum of 5 years of relevant analytical experience is required.
Demonstrated analytical and financial skills, with a firm understanding of core financial concepts and the ability to explain financial tradeoffs clearly.
Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills, with proven experience building financial models, logic formulas, and scenario analyses.
A diligent, detail-oriented skillset, with the ability to manage multiple high-velocity requests simultaneously while remaining extremely organized under tight deadlines.
A self-starter with a “can-do” attitude who is comfortable asking clarifying questions and operating with high integrity that aligns with the Twilio Magic.


Desired


Knowledge and/or experience using online sales and/or document management tools such as Salesforce, Tableau, Looker, CLM, and JIRA.


Location

This role will be remote, and based in Mexico.

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 5% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.





Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

description:
About the job

Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on the Fraud Defense Engineering team, you will be at the forefront of protecting Audible's ecosystem — safeguarding creators, listeners, and customers from fraud and abuse across all global marketplaces. You'll design and build intelligent detection systems, investigation platforms, and automated enforcement capabilities that operate at scale. This is a high-impact role where your technical decisions directly protect the integrity of our business and the trust of millions of customers worldwide.

You'll drive the team forward — anticipating threats before they materialize, innovating on detection approaches, and leading the way to develop original, effective solutions. We'll support you with the latest technologies, tools, and systems you need to succeed.

About The Team

The Fraud Defense Engineering team sits within Audible's inSpire organization. We build the tooling, platforms, and automated systems that protect the integrity and trustworthiness of Audible's business. Our primary focus areas include:


 Creator Fraud — detecting and preventing fraudulent content and manipulation of royalty systems
 Anti-Piracy — engineering protections against unauthorized distribution and content theft
 Consumer Fraud — identifying and mitigating account abuse, payment fraud, and promotional exploitation


We are also experts in ensuring that Audible meets its data handling and customer privacy obligations across all marketplaces. Joining our team provides the unique challenge and opportunity to deliver software that benefits customers around the world.

About You

You're in your element when you're being challenged, and you're always eager to share your ideas, take on responsibility, and keep developing at an exciting pace. You're looking for an environment where you can thrive, influence technical direction, and help your team reach their potential.

 Independently lead complex technical initiatives within the fraud defense domain
 Design and build scalable fraud detection systems, such as rule engines, ML-based anomaly detection, and risk scoring pipelines
 Architect real-time and batch data processing systems to aggregate fraud signals across multiple marketplaces
 Adapt and Build investigation and case management tools that empower internal operations teams
 Partner with data scientists, product managers, and policy teams to define enforcement strategies
 Mentor and support other developers by cultivating curiosity and deep technical understanding
 Write technical design documents and drive alignment across teams

About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. Basic Qualifications

 Experience building and operating near-real-time data processing systems

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience with graph-based analysis for identifying fraud rings, coordinated abuse, or account linking, and familiarity with digital rights management (DRM) or anti-piracy technologies

 Familiarity with streaming architectures (Kafka, Kinesis, Flink) for near real-time event processing and alerting
 Experience with privacy-preserving engineering practices, including data anonymization, GDPR/CCPA compliance, and PII handling
 Demonstrated ability to take a lead role in delivering complex software systems, influencing technical direction without direct authority, and navigating complex and ambiguous problem spaces
 Experience collaborating across time zones and with geographically distributed teams, working effectively in cross-functional environments

description:
About the job

About Us

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.

AI at SharkNinja 

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

Digital Sharks: Hunting Attention, Converting to Revenue

Marketplace Affiliates Associate (Early Careers)

Team: Global eCommerce, Pure Players — Marketplace Affiliates

Location: Mexico City, Mexico

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract

Duration: 6 months

Overview

At SharkNinja, we don’t just build products—we create consumer-first experiences that delight millions of customers around the world.

Digital Sharks is our early careers program for the eCommerce Pure Players business — the team responsible for how SharkNinja shows up on the world’s largest marketplaces, including Amazon, Mercado Libre and Takealot. Millions of people discover our products there every day. This program exists to turn that attention into revenue.

We’re looking for a Marketplace Affiliates Associate to join our Pure Players Marketplace Affiliates team and build our affiliate presence on the world’s largest marketplaces.

Affiliate and creator content is one of the fastest growing routes to the marketplace shopper, and one we have barely used outside the US. You will be among the first to run at it seriously in your market — getting content live, learning what works, and writing the strategy off the back of real results rather than assumptions.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is entrepreneurial, creative and comfortable starting from a blank page, and wants to build hands-on experience in affiliate and creator marketing within a fast-paced, global business.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll own a defined market and a measurable business outcome from your first month, while gaining exposure to how a global e-commerce business actually operates.

You’ll


Get 100 pieces of affiliate content live in your market within your first 30-day sprint.
Run tests outside of Creator Connections in the US and through central affiliate go-to-market in your region.
Draw clear implications from the results and write them into our Centre of Excellence playbook.
Identify, contact and onboard creators and affiliate partners in market.
Track performance by format, creator and category, and build a defensible view of what converts.
Work with Sales and Digital Marketing to make sure affiliate traffic lands on pages that are ready to convert.
Prepare recommendations and stakeholder updates for regional and central teams.
Participate in the program operating rhythm, including daily stand-ups, 30-day sprint reviews and weekly Show & Tell sessions where you present your own work.


What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, asking questions and working collaboratively to get to a better answer.

You’ll Likely Be


A recent graduate, or in the final year of a degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Media or a related discipline.
Entrepreneurial and comfortable with ambiguity — this part of the program has no established playbook.
Genuinely interested in creators, content and how people are persuaded to buy online.
Analytical and comfortable working with data to identify trends and support decision making.
A confident communicator who can turn complex information into something clear and actionable.
Proactive, collaborative and eager to learn.
Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
Working fluency in English is required.


It Would Be Great If You Also Have


Exposure to affiliate, influencer or creator marketing, including your own content.
An interest in social commerce and creator economics.
Experience using reporting or data visualisation tools.
Familiarity with affiliate tracking or attribution platforms such as Impact, Levanta or Creator Connections.
Additional language skills relevant to your market.


What You’ll Gain

At SharkNinja, you’ll be trusted with meaningful work from day one.

You’ll own a named market and a named business outcome, working alongside experienced commercial leaders on results the business is measured by.

You’ll Benefit From


Ownership of a defined market and a measurable business outcome from your first month.
Mentoring and coaching from an experienced manager, plus a named mentor one level above them.
Direct exposure to the world’s largest marketplaces — Amazon, Mercado Libre and Takealot.
Hands-on experience with AI-native tools, including our Agentic Jailbreak Big Build and APEX agents.
Cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Digital Marketing, Performance Data, Marketplace Affiliates and Media teams.
Visibility with senior leaders through weekly Show & Tell sessions, where you present your own work.
Professional development, networking opportunities and participation in our Early Careers community.


Our Culture

At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day. Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.

What We Offer

We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. We empower your personal and professional growth with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community. Together, we won’t just launch products—we’ll disrupt entire markets.

At SharkNinja, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are vital to our global success. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. We support ALL associates in bringing their authentic selves to work, making an impact, and having the opportunity for career acceleration. With help from our leadership, associates, and our community, we aim to have equity be a key component of the SharkNinja DNA.

Learn More About Us

Outrageously Extraordinary

description:
About the job

Rockstar is recruiting for a digital product studio that specializes in turning ideas into extraordinary digital experiences. This client is a dynamic, remote-first team of savvy professionals known for pushing creative boundaries and delivering high-quality, user-centered products through a collaborative and lean approach.

This client is building a bench of talented product designers for upcoming client work. They are looking for mid-to-senior-level freelance designers who can bring strong UX thinking, sharp visual design skills, and a collaborative spirit to the team.


What they're looking for



If you're a seasoned product designer with a passion for digital excellence, this opportunity is for you. You've honed your craft over the years, with a deep understanding of UX design, visual storytelling, and collaborative product development.

You're equally comfortable working independently and alongside a cross-functional team. You manage your time well, take ownership of your work, and make confident decisions with minimal oversight. You're fluent in tools like Figma and Adobe Suite, and you bring a user-first mindset to everything you do — whether designing mobile apps or contributing to product strategy.

If you're the type of designer who pushes creative boundaries, communicates clearly, and still knows how to have a little fun in the process — they'd love to hear from you.


The Details



As a Product Design Contractor, you'll contribute to a range of client-facing projects, collaborating with the Chief Creative Officer and team across the following areas:

Digital Product Design (Web & App): Shape intuitive experiences by applying research, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that elevate functionality and user engagement.
User Research & Discovery: Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to inform feature planning and prioritization. Help build products grounded in real user needs and business goals.
User Experience (UX): Apply UX methodologies like journey mapping, user flows, and usability testing to define products beyond UI — ensuring seamless and strategic user experiences.
Visual Design: Lead visual direction on select projects, producing compelling layouts and assets that translate beautifully across platforms — from product to marketing.
Presentation Collateral: Design high-impact presentation decks and visuals that bring ideas to life for clients and stakeholders.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering and product teams by providing annotated designs, QA support, and input during handoff and development.
Additional Design Support: Contribute to project-related needs like case studies, marketing assets, and content design for social media or internal documentation.

Qualifications


4-6 years of experience in product and visual design, with a strong focus on digital experiences across web and/or mobile
Solid understanding of UX principles, including user research, usability testing, and translating insights into design decisions
Demonstrated ability to own features or tracks of work with minimal oversight — from wireframes to high-fidelity execution
Comfortable leading or contributing to discovery phases and helping define product direction in collaboration with strategy and engineering
Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, with experience working in a Mac environment
Familiarity with remote collaboration tools such as Google Suite, Slack, Zoom, Jira, and Harvest
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a team-first mindset and the ability to clearly articulate design rationale
Organized, proactive, and able to manage your own time in a fast-paced, remote work environment
Bonus: experience working in client-facing or agency settings where flexibility, autonomy, and cross-functional teamwork are key

What to Expect from the Process



This is a contract-based role and part of an ongoing effort to build relationships with experienced designers for future client projects. Interviews are being conducted on a rolling basis, and while there may not be immediate openings, strong candidates will be added to the contractor roster and considered as new work becomes available.

Hiring timelines are directly tied to the sales pipeline, so project start dates vary. The team is committed to matching the right designer to the right project — and they will reach out when there's a fit.


About the Client



This client is a digital product studio that brings together design, technology, and creativity to build meaningful experiences. They believe in pushing boundaries, working collaboratively, and delivering high-quality products that they are proud of.

About MetriSense




MetriSense is a Mexican healthtech startup at pre-Seed stage, a university research spin-off (Tec de Monterrey / University of Houston) developing a point-of-care diagnostic device for metabolic syndrome. We are closing our Seed round and building the founding team.




The role




We are looking for a Chief of Staff to work directly with the CEO as a force multiplier for his execution capacity. This is not an executive assistant role and not a commercial role: it is strategic operations — taking the CEO's objectives and turning them into measurable weekly progress across every front of the company.




You will report directly to the CEO and operate at the intersection of corporate governance, fundraising, scientific-regulatory coordination, and team building.

Executive cadence: manage the CEO's priority agenda against the company roadmap; prepare and follow up on sessions with co-founders, board, advisors, and investors; ensure every agreement has an owner, a date, and follow-through.
Fundraising ops: maintain the investor CRM, data room, and version control of materials (deck, one-pagers, financial model); coordinate the logistics of the raise and prepare the CEO for every conversation.

Governance and documentation: own the company's single source-of-truth tracker; prepare minutes, decision memos, and progress reports for shareholders.
Special projects: analysis and execution of direct assignments from the CEO — from market benchmarks to preparing applications for programs and grants.




Who we're looking for




3+ years of experience in consulting, investment banking, VC, startup operations, or other high-rigor analytical and execution roles.
A demonstrated ability to run multiple workstreams in parallel with flawless follow-through — this role is measured by what gets closed, not by what gets coordinated.
Excellent executive writing in Spanish and English (we work with U.S. counterparts).
Sound judgment handling confidential information and relationships with shareholders, investors, and academics.
Nice to have: exposure to healthcare, life sciences, medical devices, or regulated environments.

What we offer

- A front-row seat building a health deeptech company from its founding stage, with direct exposure to fundraising, corporate governance, and strategy.

About Us

We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fueling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.

Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.

We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation.

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:


One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

Profitable since 2017

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1
Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo
Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting


About the Role: 

We’ve rebuilt core consumer finance products from scratch, loans, credit cards, and car finance, delivering money to customers in minutes instead of days. We are now launching our credit card product in Mexico and building our founding local team.

Customer support is critical to our success. Many of our customers are entering the formal financial system for the first time, and the way we support them matters deeply.

We’re looking for a Customer Support Agent to help deliver an excellent, friendly, and trustworthy experience to our credit card customers in Mexico.

This is a hands-on role focused on answering customer questions, resolving issues, and guiding customers through our product and processes. You’ll be on the front lines of customer interaction, helping people understand their credit card, payments, balances, and next steps.

You don’t need to build tools or write code, but you do need to be empathetic, detail-oriented, reliable, and eager to learn. Many of the questions you handle will not yet be automated, and your work will directly help us improve our product and processes over time.

What You’ll Do

 Answer Customer Questions
Respond to customer inquiries via chat, email, and eventually phone.
Help customers understand their credit card, balances, due dates, payments, and app features.
Provide clear, friendly, and accurate answers using internal tools and knowledge bases.
Escalate complex or sensitive cases when needed.

Help customers troubleshoot common issues (payments, transactions, account access).
Follow defined processes to resolve issues correctly and safely.
Identify when something doesn’t look right and raise it to the appropriate team.
Always prioritise customer trust, clarity, and compliance.
 Learn the Product Deeply
Become an expert in our credit card product, app flows, and customer policies.
Stay up to date with changes to features, processes, and FAQs.
Use internal documentation and tools to provide consistent answers.
 Improve Support Quality Over Time
Flag recurring customer issues or unclear processes to your manager.
Suggest improvements to FAQs, help articles, or canned responses.
Help identify questions that could eventually be automated.
Contribute feedback from real customer conversations to Product and Operations.


Required

Strong written communication skills in Spanish (English is a plus).
High empathy and a genuine desire to help people.
Attention to detail and ability to follow processes carefully.
Comfort using digital tools (support platforms, internal dashboards, messaging tools).
Reliability, ownership, and professionalism.
Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-moving environment.


Nice to Have

Previous experience in customer support, call centres, or service roles.
Experience supporting financial products (banking, credit cards, lending).

About the job

Why Housecall Pro?

Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America’s 100 million homes. We’re all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well.

While our headquarters are based in Denver, Colorado, our team spans the globe, with teammates across Brazil, Poland, the Philippines, Mexico, and beyond. We care deeply about our customers and foster a culture where our company, people and Pros grow and succeed together—no matter where they’re based. Leadership is as focused on growing team members’ careers as they expect their teams to be on creating solutions for Pros.

Paid holidays and flexible, take-it-as-you-need-it scheduled time off
A culture built on innovation that values big ideas, no matter where they come from

As a Specialist, Onboarding, you are a professional who thrives in ensuring a seamless and positive onboarding experience for our service professionals (our Pros) to our platform. You are responsible for coordinating and facilitating customer onboarding, while providing exceptional customer service and answering Pros' questions and concerns.

As the dedicated and primary point of contact during the most critical window post-enrollment, you take ownership of the Pro experience, guiding them through early adoption, building confidence, and ensuring they realize value quickly. You bring a proactive approach to addressing challenges, empathy, and problem-solving skills to help better our team and improve the lives of our Pros. You operate with an ownership mindset, acting as a continuation of the sales experience by reinforcing the value of HCP and ensuring Pros feel confident they made the right decision.

Our team is passionate, empathetic, hard working, and above all else focused on improving the lives of our Pros. Our success is their success.

Eloquently troubleshoot technical issues, have deep product knowledge, and think outside the box for solutions

1-3+ years experience in full-time customer success, implementation or sales

Proven success in developing relationships with new customers and exceeding success metrics
Ability to work the scheduled shifts: Monday - Friday 11am-8pm PST

Housecall Pro is growing fast and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth.

Founded in 2013, Housecall Pro helps home service professionals (Pros) streamline every aspect of their business. With easy-to-use tools for scheduling, dispatching, payments, and more, Housecall Pro enables Pros to save time, grow profitably, and provide best-in-class service.

Housecall Pro’s brand portfolio includes Business Coaching by Housecall Pro, a business coaching solution for home services businesses. Our brands are united by a singular mission to champion our Pros to success.

We support more than 50,000 businesses and have over 2,000 ambitious, mission-driven, genuinely fun-loving teammates across the globe. If you want to do work that impacts real people, supported by a team that will invest in you every step of the way, we’d love to hear from you.

About the job

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Specialist, Customer Success

Overview

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution.

Delivering with excellence for our customers is of the utmost priority, and we are expanding our Services Customer Success team to achieve this goal. This team plays a crucial role in ensuring our customers achieve their desired outcomes while maximizing the value of our products and services. Customer Success (CS) boosts Customer Lifetime Value, increases renewals and adoption, reduces support tickets, improves product feedback, builds advocacy for B2B marketing, and generates qualified sales leads.

This team will work collaboratively with cross-functional partners to address customer needs, develop tailored strategies that enhance customer satisfaction and retention, and build customer advocacy. Key outcomes of the CS team’s work will be qualified leads for value expansion and feedback for product and process improvements. By focusing on proactive engagement and personalized service, the Services Customer Success team fosters long-term relationships and contributes to the overall growth and safety of the Mastercard ecosystem.

 As a Specialist, Customer Success for Services, you will support the development and delivery of strategic priorities within the region. The candidate will focus on ensuring the priority customers and segments they work with experience positive change through more effective use of Services network products. The candidate will support senior Customer Success Managers and work closely with cross-functional teams including Network Services, Account Management, Sales, Product, Technical Account Managers and support/delivery teams to realize the full value proposition of Mastercard Network Products on behalf of the customer.

The three areas of primary responsibility include: 1) customer engagement, 2) growing the business, and 3) technical and program readiness.

Customer Engagement:


 Engage with stakeholders to study the viability of proposed solutions and understand cyber threats in financial and payment sectors
 Identify optimization opportunities for customers with the goals of driving customer value and enhanced strategic goals through our products
 Articulate key performance indicators related to cost, performance and optimization and the insights associated with them

description:
About the job

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Open Role: Marketing Associate 

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators.They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

As a Marketing Associate , you won't just be watching from the sidelines; you will be hands-on from day one, collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate complex technical innovations into compelling market value.

Location: This role will be based remote globally

What Your Day Will Look Like


GTM Support: Contribute to go-to-market planning and execution. 
Storytelling: Draft and edit compelling messaging and positioning that highlights business value for diverse target audiences. 
Campaign Coordination: Assist in developing campaign plans and content dissemination strategies to ensure our message reaches the right people. 
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with other demand generation and digital teams to help optimize marketing funnels and track campaign performance. 
Event & Social Support: Work with the wider marketing team to coordinate webinars, events, and social media promotions. 



What We Are Looking For In You


Tech Curiosity: A genuine passion for technology and a desire to learn about open source. 
Analytical Thinking: An ability to break down complex issues and translate them into clear, actionable recommendations. 
Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships within a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. 
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills; you enjoy storytelling and creating impactful content. 
Proactive Mindset: A self-starter who can prioritize tasks effectively and meet deadlines in a dynamic setting. 
Foundational Knowledge: A basic understanding of marketing principles or go-to-market strategies (via your degree, internships, or personal projects). 
Growth Mindset: Someone who is eager to learn, open to feedback, and not afraid to take on new challenges. 



What We Offer You

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.


Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
Annual compensation review
Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Parental Leave
Employee Assistance Programme
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’
Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events



About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
About the job

About Metta Dealers:




Metta Dealers is a performance marketing agency that partners with car dealerships across the U.S. to help them generate more qualified showroom traffic so they can sell more cars.




We manage the entire customer-acquisition journey—not just the advertising platforms. Our work includes paid media, creative strategy, landing pages, conversion tracking, CRM follow-up, attribution, and sales-funnel analysis.




Experience & Requirements:

This is a specialized agency-side lead-generation position. To qualify, your work history must clearly demonstrate:




•4+ years working inside a digital marketing agency, personally managing at least 10 active client accounts simultaneously with over 30k monthly advertising budgets.

• 2+ years or more managing local or appointment-based lead generation campaigns for businesses such as automotive, legal, home services, medical, dental, real estate, or similar industries.

• ADVANCED hands-on experience with Meta and Google search lead generation campaigns. You must have owned the campaigns yourself, not simply supervised others or reviewed reports.

• Strong understanding of CPM, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, CPL, contact rate, appointment rate, show rate, close rate, ROAS, and cost per sale.

• C1–C2 spoken English.

• Big Plus: Direct automotive marketing experience or a working understanding of dealership lead generation, CRM follow up, appointments, showroom traffic, financing, and vehicle sales.




About This Position:

We are looking for a senior performance marketer to own advertising performance across a portfolio of dealership accounts.
You will personally build, launch, manage, and optimize Meta and Google Ads campaigns while looking beyond the ad platforms to understand what is actually driving leads, appointments, showroom visits, and sales.
You will decide how campaigns should be structured, what gets tested and why, when to scale or pull back, and whether the data you are optimizing against can be trusted.
When performance drops, you should be able to determine whether the bottleneck is paid media, creative, landing page conversion, lead quality, CRM follow up, attribution, or another part of the funnel, then develop and implement the solution.
When needed, you should also be comfortable making changes to funnels, follow up sequences, and automation workflows.




Compensation

Salary between $2,000 - $3,500 (Depending on experience).
Performance & growth bonuses.




What Success Looks Like

You notice performance problems before someone points them out.




You understand how performance connects across: Traffic → Lead → Conversation → Appointment → Show → Sold




You think beyond CPL and understand how advertising decisions affect dealership sales.

You proactively identify new creative angles, campaign strategies, offers, and testing opportunities.

When something is not working, you have a theory, investigate it, and take ownership of solving it.




You can clearly explain what is happening, why it is happening, and what should happen next.




A Day In This Role

You will review account performance, pacing, lead volume, creative performance, funnel metrics, and lead quality.
You will optimize campaigns, launch tests, develop new strategies, review CRM conversations, and identify opportunities to improve client performance.
When creative, funnel, CRM, tracking, or technical changes are needed, you will collaborate with the appropriate team members while remaining accountable for moving the solution forward.
Depending on the situation, you may also communicate directly with dealership clients and explain complex strategies and performance data in simple business terms.




You’ll Do Well Here If

• You think about business outcomes, not just advertising metrics

• You surface problems and recommendations before someone asks

• You can confidently do a full funnel diagnosis

• You want to understand why performance changed, not simply react to it

• You stay current on Meta, Google, creative strategy, advertising trends, and new tools

• You are comfortable making judgment calls and defending them with data

• You take ownership and prefer solving problems over escalating them




This Probably Isn’t For You If

• You have never worked for a marketing agency before

• You need someone else to tell you what to do inside the ad accounts

• You stop paying attention once the lead is generated

• You are not interested in creative strategy or what happens after the click (e.g., your experience is strictly in Shopify, dropshipping, or DTC product e-commerce rather than appointment-based pipelines).

• You prefer executing tasks over diagnosing problems and developing solutions

• You need constant oversight to keep accounts moving




Schedule Details

Location: Remote
Work Schedule, Non-Negotiable: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time, U.S.
You must be able to work these exact hours consistently regardless of location.




Why Metta Dealers?

• Competitive starting salary with performance-based bonus opportunities

description:
About the job

About The Role

Shopify's brand partnerships program is built on a counterintuitive premise: the most powerful marketing we can do is invest in our merchants. One way we’ve successfully done this has been to partner directly with influential creator-merchants who actually run businesses on Shopify — from the world's largest content creators like MrBeast (Feastables), Emma Chamberlain (Chamberlain Coffee), and Alix Earle (Reale Actives), to the most recognizable names in culture: actors like Seth Rogen (Houseplant) and Pamela Anderson (Sonsie), musicians like Cardi B (Grow-Good) and Drake (OVO), athletes like Luka Dončić (77X) and Serena Williams (Wyn Beauty). To date, we’ve partnered directly with over 150 creators and dozens of celebrity/icon partnerships across North America and Europe.

When partners talk about Shopify, they're not selling software, they're promoting entrepreneurship — making a direct tie between Shopify and the agency that comes from starting a business, relatable to hundreds of millions of people. Everything we do is then intentionally woven into Shopify's full marketing strategy: crafting world class stories on owned and earned surfaces, enabling real world product marketing moments (Shopify POS powering retail activations, Shopify's AI innovation, Shop's retail companion), generating billions of earned views at industry-leading CPMs, even producing authentic creator content that fuels performance marketing with real acquisition outcomes.

This role leads a proven, growing program — and is charged with taking it into its next chapter. Today the program spans two established teams, Creator and Icon Partnerships, each run by strong leads. Your mandate is broader than either: to serve as the senior partnerships leader who both stewards those programs and extends our aperture into new territory — corporate partnerships and sponsorships (think team, venue, properties, Shopify Racing, and marquee brand deals in the multi-million-dollar range). The program has scale, craft, and momentum. The role is to widen what "brand partnerships" means at Shopify and personally carry the most complex, highest-stakes deals as we build the next several years.

You'll operate as one of the most senior leaders in Brand — part individual dealmaker on the newest and most complex partnerships, part senior leader providing air cover and direction to established programs, and a key connector across Brand, the broader marketing organization, and product.

What You'll Do:


Own and expand the partnerships portfolio including overseeing our creator and icon programs, while opening new lanes in corporate partnerships and sponsorships (e.g. sports teams, venues, properties, racing etc.)
Open and own a new corporate partnerships & sponsorships lane — inbound and outbound sponsorship evaluation plus originating and structuring strategic, multi-year, multi-million-dollar deals with teams, venues, and properties
Lead as one of the most senior leaders on the team, providing direction and accountability to a bench of established program leads — setting strategy and standards rather than owning the day-to-day of programs that already run well
Connect partnerships to Shopify's broader goals — brand, growth, revenue, and international marketing — and identify where partnerships can go that they haven't yet
Drive process and systems that let the function operate across a wider set of deal types at volume, without losing quality or accountability
Partner internally with product teams to showcase the future of commerce within partnership and sponsorship activations that create memorable, platform-differentiating moments
Travel to marquee activations, sponsorships, pop-ups, and events across North America and Europe to represent Shopify and strengthen partner relationships



What We're Looking For:


Senior, proven external-facing dealmaker: has personally negotiated large, complex, multi-year deals at a senior level — with talent, agents, and managers, and ideally with corporate partners such as sports teams, venues, or major properties
Breadth across partnership types: strength in celebrity, creator, or cultural marketing and the range or appetite to lead corporate partnerships and sponsorships — someone building toward a comprehensive partnerships portfolio, not a single specialty
In-house background required: has owned a brand partnership function, not just supported one through an agency
Budget and deal ownership: has managed $10M+ in partnership investment with accountability to ROI, and has personally carried individual high-value deals
Senior leadership range: can lead and elevate strong program leads while still rolling up their sleeves on the deals that need it — comfortable being the most senior person in the room without needing to be the deepest expert on every existing program
Cross-functional fluency: has worked closely with legal, finance, comms, product marketing, and growth teams
Cultural instinct: understands the creator economy and entrepreneur-first culture — can identify a good story and match, not just close a deal
Builder mindset: has created or significantly evolved process, tooling, or org structure in a partnership function, and is energized by expanding a function's scope
Reflexive AI use: you’re comfortable leveraging AI tools for rapid concepting and prototyping but also know when to tap others for craft expertise
Proven track record as a people manager with 8+ years of experience building, developing, and leading high-performing teams



About Shopify

Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to over 8,300 employees and generated over $1 trillion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.

This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About You

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.

Before you apply, consider if you can:


Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone
Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth
Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)
Be resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on (rather than endure) change
Bring critical thought and opinion
Put AI agents and tools to work on the tasks they're built for, and focus on the work only humans can do
Embrace differences and disagreement to get shit done and move forward
Work digital-first for your daily work



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen, select, and assess applications. All AI outputs are reviewed and validated by our recruitment team.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities


Troubleshoot and solve external user issues 
Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience 
Work closely with other Stripe teams to improve our product offerings and messaging around new products and features 
Gain unique insights into how thousands of businesses on Stripe scale and operate 
Have an opportunity to learn how Stripe operates from the ground up and make a real impact on the future of the organization 
Be a part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe 
Partner with global operations specialists or business process owners to run a critical workflow



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You have a user-first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems
You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
You excel in critical thinking and problem solving
You have prior experience in customer service or internal and external user-facing operations
You enjoy learning about technical products and processes, you're an organized, self-starter with passion for finding solutions to our user’s challenges
You have a process-oriented mindset and the ability to get things done
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support
You prioritize well and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners
You're willing to periodically work a weekend day for which you'll receive a weekday off. The SDC operates during daytime hours with shifts from the morning through early evening



Preferred Qualifications


* Prior experience or knowledge in user support
Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives 

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

description:
About the job

About Oportun

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $21.3 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

WORKING AT OPORTUN

Working at Oportun means enjoying a differentiated experience of being part of a team that fosters a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture where we all feel a sense of belonging and are encouraged to share our perspectives. This inclusive culture is directly connected to our organization's performance and ability to fulfill our mission of delivering affordable credit to those left out of the financial mainstream. We celebrate and nurture our inclusive culture through our employee resource groups.

Position Overview

Are you a data-driven lifecycle marketer with a passion for customer engagement and the technical chops to strengthen and scale customer lifecycle marketing capabilities? We're looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to join our powerhouse team and lead lifecycle strategy and execution across Oportun's product ecosystem and key member moments. You will define and execute programs across email, push, SMS, in-app, and emerging channels to drive activation, engagement, retention, product adoption, and long-term customer value.

You are responsible for both strategy and execution. This includes prioritizing lifecycle initiatives across products, ensuring campaigns run reliably, and continuously improving performance through testing, segmentation, personalization, and marketing technology enhancements. You will work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, Marketing, and Marketing Technology to deliver timely, compliant, and effective communications. You will also manage dependencies, resolve blockers, and translate business needs into clear data, platform, and execution requirements.

This role will also help advance Oportun's CLM technology capabilities. You will identify and implement opportunities such as new channel expansion, custom event integrations, improved customer data flows, AI-assisted campaign workflows, and automation that makes the CLM program more scalable, personalized, and efficient.

Success in this role means improving key lifecycle metrics across products, building scalable systems, strengthening CLM platform capabilities, and ensuring lifecycle marketing is a reliable, tech-enabled growth lever for the business.

If you're a hands-on marketer with a passion for strategic thinking, lifecycle marketing execution, data-driven decision-making, marketing technology, and customer engagement, we'd love to hear from you.

Own Lifecycle Strategy and Performance

Own performance against key engagement and business metrics, providing insights and recommendations.
Identify opportunities and prioritize initiatives based on impact, feasibility, member needs, and technical readiness.
Balance product-specific goals with shared lifecycle experiences and scalable CLM capabilities that can support multiple products and channels.

Partner with Design and Content teams to develop channel-appropriate creative and messaging.
Ensure real-time, dynamic personalization using customer data, behavioral triggers, product events, and lifecycle signals.
Design and maintain scalable, automated workflows triggered by user behavior and lifecycle stage for onboarding, activation, feature adoption, servicing, engagement, and retention.
Continuously improve targeting, timing, messaging, channel orchestration, and personalization through structured experimentation.


Advance CLM Technology and Capabilities


Lead adoption and optimization of emerging CLM capabilities, including new messaging channels, custom event integrations, AI-assisted workflows, and enhanced personalization.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Marketing Technology to improve customer data flows, event tracking, campaign triggers, APIs, and platform scalability.
Translate lifecycle marketing needs into clear technical requirements, event definitions, use cases, acceptance criteria, and implementation priorities.
Evaluate new platform features, AI use cases, and automation opportunities that can improve customer engagement, operational speed, QA, and personalization quality.
Identify and resolve gaps in data, tooling, integrations, or workflows that limit campaign execution or lifecycle program performance.


Drive Experimentation and Insights


Own testing strategy, including A/B and holdout testing to measure incremental impact.
Translate data into clear insights and actions that improve lifecycle performance across products and channels.
Partner with Analytics to ensure measurement frameworks are accurate, actionable, and connected to lifecycle and product goals.
Use learnings from campaigns, experiments, AI-assisted analysis, and member behavior to inform future strategies and platform improvements.


Manage Cross-Functional Execution


Work closely with Product and Engineering to align on priorities, data availability, event requirements, channel readiness, and implementation timelines.
Drive alignment across stakeholders and push for clarity when priorities, requirements, or technical dependencies are unclear or conflicting.
Communicate tradeoffs, risks, blockers, and recommendations clearly to help teams make informed decisions and to ensure campaigns and new capabilities are launched responsibly and effectively.

Who You Are
